summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release titled 'First Quarter 2026 Operational Update' on April 23, 2026. The release provides operational data for Q1 2026, including production figures of 27,249 boepd, drilling updates in Colombia and Argentina, and waterflooding performance. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer. This is not a special situation; it is standard periodic reporting.
